area: Character models audit: Kaito, ninja, sumo, Gorō, grandpa. Covers polish plan and zone-variant kits.
summary:
I imported all 5 team FBX files in Blender 4.4 (background mode) and checked them in four ways: stats (inspect_fbx.py), turnarounds plus game-camera renders, a lineup at true game scale (1080p, pitch 52°, 24 m, FOV 30) with the in-game heights and tints, and EEVEE moonlight renders. I also prototyped every proposed fix as bone-parented accessories and recolors, and rendered them before and after. Main findings:

(1) At gameplay scale every character is only about 100–110 px tall (Kaito 104 px, ninja 109, sumo 174, Gorō 225, Ozeki 240). Faces are a few pixels, so readability depends entirely on big colour blocks, head shapes, weapons and accessories that move.

(2) The common ninja is 98.3% one near-black material. At night it reads as a hole, and from above its front and back look the same.

(3) Kaito's hair and gi share the same material. His head is 42% of his height and the jagged hair dominates the view from above.

(4) Blades are imported with metallic = 1.0, so in URP they render almost black. Kaito's katana is a black line in the screenshots. The blade is exactly the cue the player needs for parry timing.

(5) The sumo has no topknot. His mawashi is a flared skirt with an embedded 4K photo-leather texture, which makes luchadorsumo.fbx 100 MB. Gorō uses three 4K photo textures and reads as a Western orc in a Viking helmet.

(6) The grandpa's red sash rule in export_grandpa.py matches 0 faces. The kimono has no edge loop at the waist.

(7) Kaito wears the bandana in the prologue before he gets it.

(8) Zone variants and bosses (Mizuchi, Ozeki, Kage) are only full-body tints of reused models.

(9) Shading is already flat. The files carry per-face custom normals, so nothing to change there.

Key verified fact: re-exporting through Blender 4.4 does not move the skeleton. Bind-pose rotation difference is 0.0° for all 5 FBX files, every node name is preserved, and the Kaito, ninja and sumo .anim clips animate every bone. So mesh-only edits such as face material splits and weight limiting are safe for those three. Gorō and the grandpa keep their clips inside the FBX, so for them I propose a skin-only mesh swap instead of overwriting the file.

The prototype kits cost 450–830 triangles each, which is less than any current katana mesh (about 3,000 triangles). They make every zone readable at real game pixel size under moonlight; see night_before_after_gamescale.png.

issues.title: Common ninja is a single near-black blob with no front/back cue: unreadable at night and from the 52° camera
issues.evidence: ninja_stats.json: body 'Cube' matfaces GrisOscuro #3b372d = 976 faces / 98.3% of surface area; Piel (eye slit) 0.7%, Metal 0.9%, Blanco 264 tiny faces (the kunai's handle wrap, at x0.03-0.06 y0.30-0.35 z1.29-1.40). CharacterFactory.LiftBlacks (CharacterFactory.cs:25, BlackFloor 0.13) does not touch it because its max channel is 0.23. In-game: shots/after_sumo.png and shots/intro1.png show ninjas as pure black silhouettes. lineup_gamecam.png shows front and back views identical from above. ninja_elite/mizuchi are only full-body tints (EnemyArchetypes.cs:68-70, 152-154).
issues.fix: Recolor the suit to a cool charcoal-indigo #2a2d3a and add the 'default' kit: red #b0302a hachimaki ring plus knot plus 2 long tails on bone Cabeza (the tails point backward, which reveals facing from above); a red obi on EspaldaBaja with a back knot and short tails on Root; light #8a8f99 tekko wraps on Antebrazo.L/R, which make arm wind-ups visible from above. Total 456 tris. Prototype: variants_ninja.png row 'default'; night_before_after_gamescale.png.

issues.title: Weapon materials are metallic = 1.0 and render near-black in URP; blades are 1–2 px lines (the main parry cue is invisible)
issues.evidence: kaito_stats.json: katana 'Isan' material Metal #423e3a metallic 1.0 (34.5% of the katana's area) plus a GrisOscuro handle (29%). ninja katana Metal #8596b2 metallic 1.0 (56%), Plateado metallic 1.0, Negro #000000 37.3%. The metas use materialImportMode 2 (embedded material description), so these values reach URP Lit as they are. shots/close_0.png: Kaito's katana is a black stick. shots/intro1.png: the ninja blade is dark blue. Blade cross-section in FBX space: Isan dims 2.02 x 0.166 x 0.072 u.
issues.fix: Use name-based swaps: Metal and Plateado become metallic 0, albedo #c9d1dc/#e6eaf0, smoothness about 0.3. Give every weapon a dedicated 'Glint' material slot on the blade edge (emission driven by code at the AttackDef telegraph: gold for Parryable, red for Unblockable). Thicken Kaito's blade (Isan local Y×1.8, Z×1.6; prototype polish_kaito.png) or rebuild it at 300–500 tris.

issues.title: No readability lighting for characters at night: dark costumes vanish; no rim/fresnel term exists in the project
issues.evidence: Grep found no rim/fresnel character shader (only UI/Telegraph/Foliage/Sky/Water shaders and Shader/*.shadergraph VFX). shots/boss_ozeki1.png and after_sumo.png: Kaito and enemies are about 50 px dark blobs. In raw/lineup_night_front.png, under a moon key the dark suits drop to almost the ground value.
issues.fix: Add a Shader Graph 'Nindo/CharacterLit': URP Lit plus a view fresnel rim (colour #9fc2ff, strength 0.3, power 3) plus _EmissionColor for glint and hit flash. CharacterFactory.BuildModel converts each character material to it (copy _BaseColor/_BaseMap) before LiftBlacks. No model edit needed.

issues.title: Kaito: hair and gi share one material, so the head and body merge; the hair is about 40% of his silhouette from above
issues.evidence: kaito_stats.json: Cuerpo GrisOscuro #3b372d = 58.7% of area (gi plus hair plus eyes/brows). Head (cabeza-dominated verts, z1.79-2.97 of 0.13-2.97) = 41.5% of height (ninja 28.6%, sumo 28%, Gorō 26%). Skin Piel #f69c48 reads as orange plastic (shots/close_0.png). kaito_idle_views.png and lineup_gamecam.png: from the game camera only the spiky dark hair reads.
issues.fix: Mesh pass, safe re-export (see plan): GrisOscuro faces with dominant bone 'cabeza' and (z>2.28 or x<0.30) go to new material 'Pelo' #1b1716 (290 faces; eyes/brows stay, verified in render), and their up-facing faces (n.z>0.55, 71) go to 'PeloBrillo' #3a2c27 to show volume. Gi #2e3a5e indigo (option A) or #30343f charcoal-blue (option B). Piel #e0a072, trim #e8b030, AmarilloBandana #ffc21a with emission tied to Spirit. Add 2 long bandana tails (spring chain) on cabeza. Prototype polish_kaito.png (rows polish, polish_b).

issues.title: Model-side support for telegraph readability is missing: no glint slots on striking parts, Gorō's eyes are hidden
issues.evidence: Striking parts share materials with non-striking parts: ninja katana Metal is also on the kunai blade; Gorō's hammer head 'MartilloMiniJefe' is a photo texture; the sumo is unarmed with no hand/forearm wraps. Gorō's eyes are 2 faces (RojoOjosMiniJefe, emissive #ac0202) at y=-0.30 under the helmet, not visible from 52°. Enemy.cs:118 already finds weapons by name for trails.
issues.fix: Use one emissive 'Glint' slot per attacker: ninja blade edge, Gorō hammer head (and eyes ×4 emission plus a small red point light), sumo forearm wraps or Palma.L/R hand wraps (accessory). The combat code lerps _EmissionColor during the telegraph window. Accessory names must avoid the substrings that Enemy.cs:118 and PlayerController.cs:91/100-109 match: Katana, Isan, Cylinder, Martillo, Arma (careful: 'Armadura' contains 'Arma'), and Cube (NPC.cs:22-24).

issues.title: Sumo: no topknot/hair, skirt-like 'Pollera' with a 4K photo texture; FBX 100 MB near GitHub's limit
issues.evidence: sumo_stats.json: one mesh with Piel #ffb056 76.9%, Pollera 22.6% (base colour linked to fabric_leather_01_diff_4k.jpg plus nor_gl_4k.png, both packed). luchadorsumo.fbx = 100,050,844 bytes; the roundtrip re-export without embedded images = 235 KB (rt/sumo_rt.fbx). No LFS in .gitattributes. variants_sumo.png 'base': a bald egg from above. 185 verts carry 5–8 bone influences.
issues.fix: Add HairCap ellipsoid (Cabeza) c(0,-0.25,4.45) r(0.60,0.62,0.45) #1c1c20, chonmage c(0,-0.06,4.93) r(0.12,0.30,0.09), and a motoyui tie #ece6da. Pollera becomes a flat mawashi colour; reassign its top face loop to a darker belt material (better than my prototype ring, which floats over the belly). Add 9 sagari strands and a back knot on Root. Strip the textures, Limit Total 4 plus Normalize, and re-export. Skin #d9936a. Prototype variants_sumo.png 'default'.

issues.title: Gorō: photo textures on faceted low-poly, Western orc/Viking read, one rope material also used for the boots
issues.evidence: Minijefe.fbx.meta remaps to Materials/*MiniJefe 1.mat: Armadura uses plastered_stone_wall_diff_4k.jpg (11.6 MB), Cuero uses fabric_leather (9.4 MB), Martillo uses rock_boulder_dry (28.9 MB); PielMiniJefe 1.mat _BaseColor (0.29,0.23,0.08) (olive-brown). Minijefe.fbx 68 MB. CuerdaMiniJefe spans z -0.008..1.48 (rope belt plus boots, 824 faces). Hammer mesh 3390 tris with 792 non-manifold edges. goro_turnaround_rest.png shows a horned Viking helmet.
issues.fix: Runtime swaps: skin #8f3a2a (aka-oni red, pops on snow), armour flat #8a8a86 with no _BaseMap, leather #4a3628, hammer #5f615f, eyes emission ×4. Skin-only mesh swap: 34 horn faces (Armadura and Cabeza and z>2.78 and |x|>0.24) to gold #d9a93a, which turns the horns into kabuto kuwagata; up-facing faces (40 armour, 47 hammer) to snow #e8eef5; Cuerda faces with z>0.95 (660) to straw rope #c9b27a, the rest (boots) #3b2a20. Add 4 shide zigzags #f4f1e8 on the rope (Root). Prototype polish_goro.png.

issues.title: Grandpa's red sash is missing: the exporter rule matches 0 faces and the kimono has no edge loop at the waist
issues.evidence: Tools/Blender/characters/export_grandpa.py:54 (rule `dom == "Root" and 1.25 < c.z < 1.45 -> Faja`); grandpa_stats.json has no Abuelo_Faja in matfaces. Kimono face-row histogram: rows at z 0.7/0.8/1.0/1.1 then 1.6/1.7, nothing in between. The hat (#c9a868, 32.9% of area) is almost the palette 'path' colour #b9a074. The grandpa idle clip is a static 0.033 s frame (clips/index.txt).
issues.fix: Either use an accessory sash ring on Root (section at z 1.42 +0.03, h 0.16, #8a2b22, back knot; prototype polish_grandpa.png), or bmesh.bisect two loops at z≈1.36/1.50 in export_grandpa.py (edge splits interpolate the deform weights) and assign Faja. Add the scythe with Kaito's yellow ribbon (#f2cc4a, same as props_misc.py:742 build_scythe) strapped on his back (Torso) in the home section as foreshadowing. Optionally deepen the hat to #b8924f.

issues.title: Kaito wears the bandana in the prologue before receiving it
issues.evidence: The bandana is baked into 'Cuerpo' (AmarilloBandana, 52 faces, z2.29-2.51). PlayerController.SetKatanaVisible (PlayerController.cs:100-109) only toggles Isan/Katana renderers. Story: StoryText.cs:104 'La cinta... ¡se me ató sola!', StoryDirector.cs:166-217 BandanaAwakening.
issues.fix: Until Flags.KatanaObtained, swap the AmarilloBandana slot to the hair material (prototype polish_kaito.png row 'prologue'). In BandanaAwakening, swap it back with an emissive flash; the bandana tails accessory spawns at the same moment.

issues.title: Zone variants and 3 of 4 bosses are only tinted or scaled reuses
issues.evidence: EnemyArchetypes.cs: sumo_mountain tint (0.35,0.45,0.75)@0.45 (109-110); mizuchi = ninja ×1.3 tint (0.2,0.65,0.8)@0.5 (152-154); ozeki = sumo ×1.35 tint (0.55,0.15,0.12)@0.35 (178-180); kage = Kaito tint (0.12,0.08,0.2)@0.8 plus emission (203-207). lineup_gamecam.png: they read as recoloured grunts; Ozeki (3.375 m, 240 px) is bigger than Gorō (3.2 m). CharacterFactory.Tint (154) would also tint any accessory.
issues.fix: Replace tints with the variant kit system (plan step 3). Set tintStrength = 0 for kit variants. Ozeki gets the 'ozeki' kit now (ōichō, white tsuna plus shide, purple kesho-mawashi with bamboo crest; 792 tris). Mizuchi and Kage need their own models (separate design tasks) but should use the same kit/rebind pipeline.

issues.title: Skin weights above 4 influences are truncated by Unity
issues.evidence: influences_hist: sumo 185 verts with 5–8 influences, Gorō 117 (5–6), Kaito 64 (5–6), ninja 46 (5–7), grandpa 41 (5–7). All metas: maxBonesPerVertex 4, skinWeightsMode 0.
issues.fix: In every re-export script: vertex_group_limit_total(limit=4) plus vertex_group_normalize_all(lock_active=False) before export, so Unity deforms exactly like Blender.

issues.title: Triangle waste in weapons; tiny details invisible at game scale
issues.evidence: Kaito katana 'Isan' 3054 tris (body 3046; 1254 faces are the white handle wrap; 28 loose parts). Ninja katana 3324 tris (body 2698). Gorō hammer 3390 tris. In-game the weapons are 1–3 px wide (lineup_gamecam.png).
issues.fix: Rebuild weapons at 300–500 tris with 3 material slots (steel, Glint edge, wrap); keep object names and parent bones (Isan→KatanaBone, Katana→Katana, Cylinder.005→BaseM).

issues.title: Faces are only readable in cutscenes, and Kaito's eyes are flat dark quads
issues.evidence: At gameplay a face is 15–20 px and eyes 2–3 px. kaito_turnaround_rest.png: eyes and brows are GrisOscuro shapes with no whites or catchlight; Kaito has no shape keys. Cutscenes use close follow shots (StoryDirector.cs:145, 363).
issues.fix: Add 2 tiny catchlight quads (#ffffff, emission 0.3) per eye parented to cabeza, plus an optional procedural blink (scale an eyelid quad every 3–5 s). Cutscene-only value, cheap.

issues.title: Index-based materialOverrides are fragile across renderers
issues.evidence: CharacterFactory.cs:94-100 applies entry.materialOverrides[i] to slot i of every renderer (body and weapon have different slot orders, e.g. Cuerpo slot0 GrisOscuro, Isan slot0 GrisOscuro by coincidence).
issues.fix: Use name-based swaps (MaterialSwap{sourceName, color, metallic, smoothness, emission, clearBaseMap}), matched on the material name without '.00x' or '(Instance)' suffixes.

issues.title: Repository hygiene: large and unreferenced duplicate FBX files
issues.evidence: Characters/Sumo/2.fbx = 100,465,708 bytes; its GUID da4da99e... is not referenced by any .asset/.unity/.prefab/.controller/.anim. Junk duplicates in Assets/Models: BLABLABLABLABLA2.fbx, UIOAWUHNDOULWAHIDYYWGTUIDSUDOIWQGHIDUHOWIA.fbx, 'kaito (1).fbx', kaito_.fbx, KaitoModel.fbx. Unused slots: Kaito 'Rojo', ninja 'Rojo.010', grandpa '.001' ninja materials.
issues.fix: Team decision: remove or move unused FBX files out of Assets; re-export the sumo without embedded textures (shrinks from about 100 MB to about 0.3 MB).

issues.title: Shading already flat: no change needed (verification note)
issues.evidence: All team meshes carry custom split normals (HAS_CUSTOM_NORMALS True). The 'asis' render is identical to forced flat (shading_compare.png). Matches STYLE.md 'faceted low-poly, flat shading'.
issues.fix: Keep it. Optional: 35° auto-smooth only on the sumo skin to remove noisy belly triangulation (shading_compare.png 'auto35').

plan:
CONVENTIONS USED BELOW
- Coordinates are in the Blender import space of each team FBX: Z up, units as imported.
- Facing (verified; matches NindoContent.modelYaw):
  - Kaito and ninja face +X (yaw 90).
  - Sumo and grandpa face +Y (yaw 180).
  - Gorō faces -Y (yaw 0).
- Height in Blender units and in game metres: Kaito 2.83 u = 1.5 m; ninja 2.88 u = 1.7 m; sumo 4.85 u = 2.5 m; Gorō 2.97 u = 3.2 m; grandpa 3.18 u = 1.45 m.
- Every accessory position below is the value used in the working prototype: scratchpad/phaseA/models/kit_variants.py with helpers in kitlib.py. Those scripts are the starting point for the production script.

STEP 0 — Safety rules, proved by measurement
- Blender 4.4 re-export of each team FBX was compared on the FBX BindPose matrices (roundtrip.py):
  - Every node name is preserved.
  - Max bind rotation difference is 0.0°.
  - Max translation difference is ≤0.003 FBX units.
- The Kaito/ninja/sumo .anim clips animate every bone, so the different default pose after re-export is irrelevant.
- Therefore:
  - (a) Kaito (kaitooo.fbx), ninja (Ninja 1.fbx) and sumo (luchadorsumo.fbx) may be overwritten in place, keeping the .meta/GUID. Use exactly these settings: export_scene.fbx(object_types={ARMATURE,MESH}, apply_unit_scale=True, apply_scale_options='FBX_SCALE_NONE', axis_forward='-Z', axis_up='Y', add_leaf_bones=False, primary_bone_axis='Y', secondary_bone_axis='X', bake_anim=False).
  - (b) Keep these names exactly: object names (Cuerpo, Isan, Cube, Katana), 'Armature', bone names, and material names.
  - (c) Always Limit Total 4 plus Normalize weights before export.
  - (d) Never overwrite Minijefe.fbx or Grandpa.fbx (their clips live inside). For mesh edits on those two, export a skin-only FBX (armature plus mesh, no animation) and swap SkinnedMeshRenderer.sharedMesh in an editor step, remapping bone indices by bone name. Bindposes are identical, so they can be copied.
  - (e) Grandpa uses export_grandpa.py settings (FBX_SCALE_UNITS), not (a).
- Add a validator to the pipeline (roundtrip.py logic) that fails if any bind rotation is >0.01° or any node name changes.

STEP 1 — Unity-only fixes, no model edits (highest value, lowest risk)
1.1 Name-based material swaps
- In NindoContent.CharacterEntry, add MaterialSwap[] {string material; Color color; float metallic; float smoothness; Color emission; bool clearBaseMap}.
- Apply them in CharacterFactory.BuildModel before LiftBlacks.
- Retire the index-based materialOverrides (CharacterFactory.cs:94-100).
- Values:
  - kaito: GrisOscuro #2e3a5e (or #30343f), Piel #e0a072, Amarillo #e8b030, AmarilloBandana #ffc21a, Metal #c9d1dc m0 s0.3, Blanco #ece6da, Dorado #b8923a m0.
  - ninja: GrisOscuro #2a2d3a, Metal #c9d1dc m0, Plateado #e6eaf0 m0, Negro #3a2422.
  - sumo: Piel #d9936a, Pollera #2e3d6b with clearBaseMap.
  - goro: PielMiniJefe #8f3a2a, ArmaduraMiniJefe #8a8a86 (clearBaseMap), CueroMiniJefe #4a3628 (clear), MartilloMiniJefe #5f615f (clear), RojoOjosMiniJefe emission ×4.
  - Set smoothness to about 0.15 on cloth and skin.
1.2 Shader
- Create 'Nindo/CharacterLit' (URP Lit plus fresnel rim #9fc2ff ×0.3, power 3, plus _EmissionColor).
- Convert character materials to it in BuildModel.
1.3 Glint hook
- Add CharacterFX.Glint(renderer, slotName, color, t).
- Combat code calls it during AttackDef.telegraph: gold #ffd86b for Parryable, red #ff4a3a for Unblockable.
1.4 Prologue bandana
- While !Flags.KatanaObtained, swap AmarilloBandana to the hair colour (#3b372d, or 'Pelo' after step 4).
- Restore it in StoryDirector.BandanaAwakening with an emissive flash.

STEP 2 — Kaito's bandana as a diegetic Spirit meter
- Drive the AmarilloBandana emission (0 → 1.2) with Spirit 0 → 100%.
- When Spirit is full, pulse at about 1.5 Hz on the tails.
- This makes the yellow dragon HUD and the yellow bandana tell the same story.

STEP 3 — Variant kit system (zone variants without touching the team skeletons)
3.1 Blender
- Write Tools/Blender/characters/build_kits.py from kitlib/kit_variants:
  - Import the team FBX, leave the armature untouched, and build accessories in rest-pose world space.
  - Rigid pieces are parented to a bone.
  - Tails are skinned ribbons on new chain bones 'Acc_Tail*' parented to the head bone (3 bones per tail).
  - Export 'Kit_<char>_<variant>.fbx' (armature plus accessory meshes only) with STEP 0(a) settings.
- Naming:
  - Prefix every accessory 'Acc_'.
  - Never use the substrings Katana, Isan, Cylinder, Martillo, Arma, or Cube. Enemy.cs:118, PlayerController.cs:91/100-109 and NPC.cs:22-24 match those names.
  - Example: name a piece 'Acc_SnowPlate', not 'ArmaduraSnow'.
- Materials: palette colours from nindo_palette.py, one material per colour. Workbench preview plus a game-scale contact sheet go into CI (varsheet.py).
3.2 Unity
- Add NindoContent.CharacterVariant {id, character, GameObject kit, MaterialSwap[] swaps}.
- Add EnemyConfig.variant. EnemyFactory chooses the variant from the encounter zone:
  - cp_mountain* → mountain
  - cp_lake* → lake
  - cp_bamboo → bamboo
  - everything else → default
  - elite archetype → elite
- Set tintStrength = 0 for kit variants.
- Attach inside BuildModel, before HitFlash/KatanaRig cache renderers:
  - Instantiate the kit.
  - Map live bones by name.
  - Rigid accessories: copy local TRS under the matching live bone.
  - New chain bones: reparent under their live parent bone.
  - SkinnedMeshRenderers: remap .bones and .rootBone by name; keep bindposes (skeletons are identical, STEP 0).
  - Destroy the kit skeleton.
- Secondary motion:
  - SpringChain (verlet: stiffness 0.08, drag 0.15, gravity 1, sphere collider on head/torso, max angle 70°) on tail chains.
  - SpringPivot (single joint, ±35°) on obi tails, shide, sagari.
  - Feed the root acceleration from ProceduralMotion so dashes whip the tails.
3.3 Kit contents (as prototyped, tris measured)
- NINJA. Shared anchors:
  - Head centre (0.015, -0.022, 2.50).
  - Hachimaki ring at z 2.665, rx 0.392, ry 0.352, h 0.10, t 0.04, tilted 8° front-down; knot at (-0.395, -0.02, 2.69).
  - Tails from the knot down the back to about (-0.65, ±0.2, 1.95), width 0.15–0.17.
  - Obi ring at z 1.36, rx 0.36, ry 0.38, h 0.15 on EspaldaBaja; knot at x -0.38; tails on Root.
  - Tekko rings on Antebrazo.L/R at (-0.185, ±0.93, 1.89), r 0.155, length 0.27.
  - Kyahan rings on Tibia.L/R at (-0.07, 0.205/-0.245, 0.42), r 0.185.
- NINJA variants:
  - default (Kurokage clan; fields, forest, wall, garden, dojo): suit #2a2d3a; hachimaki and obi #b0302a; wraps #8a8f99 — 456 tris.
  - elite: suit #2a2226; adds sode plates #a8322a on Brazo.L/R and a red oni menpo #a8322a with #ece6da teeth on Cabeza — 504 tris.
  - mountain (Kodoyama): suit #4b5361; fur collar #dfe5ec over a #8e97a3 ring on EspaldaAlta; hachimaki #c9ced6 with #9aa3ad tails; straw rope belt #c9b27a plus 3 shide #f4f1e8 (echoes Gorō's shimenawa); wraps #9aa3ad plus kyahan #c9b27a — 816 tris; FX: breath puffs.
  - lake (Kohan): suit #1d4352; jingasa cone r 0.62, h 0.24 #2f3640 with #3f7f8f rim and knob (add a white wave crest on top); teal obi; rope bandolier on EspaldaAlta rotated X 38°; glowing ukidama float #7ff0e0 (emission 2) on Root as the night identifier; wraps #cfe7ec — 594 tris.
  - bamboo (Take): suit #2b3a26; 6+6 takezane slats on chest and back (EspaldaAlta), lightened to #c9b46a after the night test; cords #4e6b2a; leaf-shaped hachimaki tails #a4c25a; takezutsu flask on Root — 732 tris.
  - Katana handle colour per zone: #3a2422 / #c9b27a / #3f7f8f / #7fa140.
- SUMO. Base fix for all variants:
  - HairCap and chonmage plus motoyui (Cabeza), coordinates as in issue MODEL-06.
  - Mawashi belt from the Pollera top face loop.
  - 9 sagari 0.06×0.06×0.72 at the front (y≈1.0, x -0.48..0.48) and a back knot 0.42×0.20×0.38 at (0, -1.24, 2.22), all on Root.
- SUMO variants:
  - default: mawashi #2e3d6b, sagari #24305a — 456 tris.
  - mountain: mawashi #4a4d52; straw rope #c9b27a; fur pelt on Hombro.L; stone bracers #6f716f with snow caps on Antebrazo.L/R — 832 tris.
  - lake: mawashi #2f6f7f, sagari #7fb8b0; rope sash across the chest (Torso, rotated Y 38°); tenugui headband #cfe7ec knotted in front; ukidama float on the back — 696 tris.
  - bamboo: mawashi #3a5a2a with bamboo-slat sagari #b8a35a — 456 tris.
  - ozeki (boss): ōichō fan topknot; mawashi #5b3a6b; kesho apron #5b3a6b with #d9a93a border and 3 bamboo stalks #7fa140; white tsuna #ece6da (r 1.36/1.16, thickness 0.18) with 4 shide — 792 tris.
- Animation hook per variant: an AnimatorOverrideController slot for stance clips (mountain: heavy shoulders-up idle; lake: low flowing guard; bamboo: crouched stealth). The animation task owns the clips.

STEP 4 — Mesh polish passes (re-export per STEP 0)
